No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex. Over. And over. And over. This is the reality of child trafficking. Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. Free. Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal. She took the first step toward healing. This rescue was possible because people chose to act. The Sound of Freedom Foundation exists to stop the sale of God 's children. Inspired by the film Sound of Freedom , the Foundation works around the world to prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children. Our mission is simple. To stop the sale of God 's children. And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our Freedom Strike Force partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues. | | | | | Children like Kristen are waiting. But these missions cannot happen without support from people who care. That is why I am reaching out to you today. Your donation today can help: Train officers to find trafficked children Support rescue operations Provide food, clothing, and care for survivors Help children begin the journey to healing When I first heard the stories of trafficked children, I asked myself a question. What if it were my child? I could not stay silent. And you do not have to either. Friend, will you please help rescue the next child today? Your gift -- whatever God places on your heart -- will help bring freedom to children still waiting in the dark. Together we can make sure more children hear the Sound of Freedom. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. The cost to staff, equip, and execute a Freedom Strike Force Training Camp is $25,000. To raise these funds, I need Freedom Fighters like you to rally in support and sponsor this mission. Please pray about what you can do to help and donate today. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074 Pop Acta Media | Conservative Innovation PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2275%2E259176%2EESp-EV) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2275%2E259176%2EESp-EV)_

Peter, in case you haven't heard: **Republicans passed their racist, outrageous gerrymandered districts in Tennessee that eliminate District 9 as the only majority-Black and majority-Democratic district in our state.** They have cheated their way into a map that favors Republicans, where politicians are picking their voters instead of voters picking their leaders. Donald Trump's hand-picked Supreme Court took a sledgehammer to one of the most important civil rights laws in American history. They gutted the Voting Rights Act — allowing states to redraw maps that slice up diverse districts. For instance: After their decision, Tennessee Republicans wasted no time in redistricting their House map to slice Memphis into three different districts. Louisiana Republicans just advanced a map that eliminates a Democratic district. And they lifted a mandate for Alabama to use a map with two majority-Black districts. Let’s be clear about what this means: They're blatantly trying to silence Black voters to try and hold onto power. We must fight back using every lever we’ve got. So I’m calling on Congress to step up and pass federal voting rights protections. I’m donating resources to states with races in 2026 so Democrats can win back our majorities. And I’m fighting for Supreme Court reform so we can root corruption out of the judiciary and expand the court. **But we’ve also got to make sure that state parties have the resources they need to fight back and defend disenfranchised voters.** [**So I’m asking you to make a split contribution to state parties in Alabama, Tennessee, Louisiana, and South Carolina. These are states that are fighting the immediate repercussions of this ruling — and who could use strong support right now.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3645?t=8&akid=2904%2E4032634%2ExneSol)

subject: Exposing the Supreme Court’s emergency loophole

A new
report confirms what we’ve been warning about for years: Chief Justice
John Roberts didn’t just allow the Supreme Court’s “shadow docket” to
spiral out of control — he helped design the system that made it possible.

What was meant for rare emergencies is now the Court’s go-to loophole:
major rulings issued behind closed doors, with no hearings, no
transparency, and often no explanation.

And Trump knows exactly how to exploit it.

Every time a lower court blocks one of his unlawful power grabs, he races
to the Supreme Court demanding “emergency” intervention.

And this Court keeps bailing him out.

More than 30 emergency appeals.
Nearly an 80% success rate.

These aren’t harmless procedural rulings — they’re reshaping the country
overnight.

Protections disappear. Federal workers get purged. Presidential power
expands. Rights vanish with a late-night order. No accountability. No
transparency. No restraint.

Roberts normalized it. Trump weaponized it. And now an extremist Court is
using the shadow docket to force an agenda that would never survive public
scrutiny.

Demand Justice PAC is fighting to drag these abuses into the light and
build the pressure necessary to force real Supreme Court reform — from
binding ethics rules to structural reforms that impose checks on this
out-of-control institution.

But none of that happens without public pressure strong enough to make
inaction politically impossible.

| **__A Personal Note from Elise Stefanik__**
---
Friend,
---
First of all, I want to thank you for all your support over the years.
---
We never could have sent President Trump back to the White House with Republican majorities without YOUR unwavering commitment and dedication to our grassroots movement.
---
As you probably know, I’m not running for reelection this year.
---
_But that doesn’t mean I’m done fighting to Make America Great Again!_
---
The midterm elections are now looming, and the stakes couldn’t be higher.
---
If the Democrats retake the House, it will effectively mean the END of Trump’s presidency!
---
President Trump said it himself...
---
**_“You got to win the midterms... [or] they’ll find a reason to impeach me. I’ll get impeached.”_**
---
**That’s why I promised the President that I would use every minute of my remaining time in Congress to do everything in my power to ensure we DEFEND his House Majority.**
---
_Since I no longer need funds for my own campaign, I’ve decided the most effective way I can help is to use my grassroots donor network –**among the most powerful in the entire country** – to help America First Republicans WIN the midterms’ key battleground races._
---
You’ve always had my back when I needed it most, Friend.
---
Now, I’m humbly asking for your help winning this one FINAL battle – _not for me, but for our country._

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

| Letter from the Chair
---
Onward to the General Election
Nebraska's May 12 primary is now in the books, and the post-election analysis is everywhere. For political junkies, the Monday morning quarterbacking has not been in short supply.
Turnout hit a historic low--just 27% statewide, down from 34% in 2022. Yet the Nebraskans who did vote delivered strong, clear results for conservative leadership. Incumbents including Governor Jim Pillen and U.S. Senator Pete Ricketts secured the GOP nod.
And in the biggest story of the night, Scott Petersen delivered a decisive upset over two-term incumbent Secretary of State Bob Evnen, revealing that election confidence is a persistent issue among Nebraska voters. Social media lit up with celebration from conservatives who see this as a grassroots win for restoring trust in our elections, while Petersen himself stated: "It's time to bring the party together and now we are going to be a true MAGA state."
A heartfelt hat tip to every candidate who ran and didn't advance -- I know firsthand how these races feel. After running and losing a Douglas County Commissioner race in 2016, I remember the sting, even when you know the math and the map aren't on your side. But here's what I learned: the experience is never wasted. Door-knocking humbles you, and listening to your neighbors' real struggles changes how you see every future race. The anonymous trolls and keyboard warriors are brutal, but their public jabs at your character force you to decide what's worth your time -- and what isn't.
As a candidate, your effort mattered. You built relationships, sharpened conservative ideas, and stayed engaged. Stay in the fight. There are countless ways to serve--local party work, issue advocacy, supporting the ticket. Keep those doors open and those relationships strong.
To our winners heading into the general election--congratulations! The real work starts now. Review the primary numbers, refine your message, and tighten your ground game. There's time for a quick breather, but not much of one.
We need to address how to counter our candidates being out funded. A wealthy few within Nebraska and many outside our state are funding the Democrats through ActBlue and their NGO networks. How can we best work together to re-engage our donor base and to amplify our limited resources?
For the rest of us in party leadership and supportive roles--volunteers, donors, activists--we have the same task. Study the map. Prioritize our limited resources. And above all, bring every candidate team and every faction of our party together. Cohesion and cooperation are the critical components that lead to victory.
Nebraskans didn't turn out in big numbers for the primary, but we can give them a powerful reason to vote in November. The gap between proven Republican principles and radical Democrat policies has never been wider. From open borders and soft-on-crime extremism to attacks on parental rights and Nebraska values, the contrast is stark.
Let's keep the Good Life in Nebraska--strong families, safe communities, secure elections, and opportunity for all. Onward to victory in November!

In Liberty and in Truth, Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair Onward to the General Election Nebraska's May 12 primary is now in the books, and the post-election analysis is everywhere. For political junkies, the Monday morning quarterbacking has not been in short supply. Turnout hit a historic low--just 27% statewide, down from 34% in 2022. Yet the Nebraskans who did vote delivered strong, clear results for conservative leadership. Incumbents including Governor Jim Pillen and U.S. Senator Pete Ricketts secured the GOP nod. And in the biggest story of the night, Scott Petersen delivered a decisive upset over two-term incumbent Secretary of State Bob Evnen, revealing that election confidence is a persistent issue among Nebraska voters. Social media lit up with celebration from conservatives who see this as a grassroots win for restoring trust in our elections, while Petersen himself stated: "It's time to bring the party together and now we are going to be a true MAGA state." A heartfelt hat tip to every candidate who ran and didn't advance -- I know firsthand how these races feel. After running and losing a Douglas County Commissioner race in 2016, I remember the sting, even when you know the math and the map aren't on your side. But here's what I learned: the experience is never wasted. Door-knocking humbles you, and listening to your neighbors' real struggles changes how you see every future race. The anonymous trolls and keyboard warriors are brutal, but their public jabs at your character force you to decide what's worth your time -- and what isn't. As a candidate, your effort mattered. You built relationships, sharpened conservative ideas, and stayed engaged. Stay in the fight. There are countless ways to serve--local party work, issue advocacy, supporting the ticket. Keep those doors open and those relationships strong. To our winners heading into the general election--congratulations! The real work starts now. Review the primary numbers, refine your message, and tighten your ground game. There's time for a quick breather, but not much of one. We need to address how to counter our candidates being out funded. A wealthy few within Nebraska and many outside our state are funding the Democrats through ActBlue and their NGO networks. How can we best work together to re-engage our donor base and to amplify our limited resources? For the rest of us in party leadership and supportive roles--volunteers, donors, activists--we have the same task. Study the map. Prioritize our limited resources. And above all, bring every candidate team and every faction of our party together. Cohesion and cooperation are the critical components that lead to victory. Nebraskans didn't turn out in big numbers for the primary, but we can give them a powerful reason to vote in November. The gap between proven Republican principles and radical Democrat policies has never been wider. From open borders and soft-on-crime extremism to attacks on parental rights and Nebraska values, the contrast is stark. Let's keep the Good Life in Nebraska--strong families, safe communities, secure elections, and opportunity for all. Onward to victory in November! Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world.

| | |

| |

| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|

| | Friend, No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there.
Alone. There was no bathroom.
Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex.
Over. And over. And over. **This is the reality of child trafficking.**
---

Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...**she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. **They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. **Free.** Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal**.**

**She took the first step toward healing.** **This rescue was possible because people chose to act.**
---

The **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists to _stop_ _ __the sale __of God 's children._ Inspired by the film _Sound of Freedom_ , the Foundation works around the world to **prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children.** Our mission is simple. **To stop the sale of God 's children.** And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our **Freedom Strike Force** partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. **Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues.**

clean_body: Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend, No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there. Alone. There was no bathroom. Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex. Over. And over. And over. This is the reality of child trafficking. Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. Free. Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal. She took the first step toward healing. This rescue was possible because people chose to act. The Sound of Freedom Foundation exists to stop the sale of God 's children. Inspired by the film Sound of Freedom , the Foundation works around the world to prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children. Our mission is simple. To stop the sale of God 's children. And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our Freedom Strike Force partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues. | | | | | Children like Kristen are waiting. But these missions cannot happen without support from people who care. That is why I am reaching out to you today. Your donation today can help: Train officers to find trafficked children Support rescue operations Provide food, clothing, and care for survivors Help children begin the journey to healing When I first heard the stories of trafficked children, I asked myself a question. What if it were my child? I could not stay silent. And you do not have to either. Friend, will you please help rescue the next child today? Your gift -- whatever God places on your heart -- will help bring freedom to children still waiting in the dark. Together we can make sure more children hear the Sound of Freedom. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. The cost to staff, equip, and execute a Freedom Strike Force Training Camp is $25,000. To raise these funds, I need Freedom Fighters like you to rally in support and sponsor this mission. Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

**What happens when reliably red states start slipping away?**

We’ve seen it before, the other way around: **In 2016, Trump flipped Michigan and Wisconsin. In 2024, he took Nevada for the first time in two decades.**

Democrats didn’t have a contingency plan, and they paid for it.

With your help, we can flip this seat, double the number of SEALs in the U.S. Senate, and give our party critical reinforcements no matter what happens in the South or the Far North. That’s why I’m writing today: Every dollar will be used to protect and expand our Senate majority — even if some of our traditional strongholds fall. clean_body: Memorial Day 2026: Honor our veterans with me It's Gary Sinise here. | | | | Friend, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Friend, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Friend, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. My fellow Americans - this is your Vice President.
[I hope this email finds you well. Admittedly, it’s a bit longer than my typical message to you, but I’m betting it’ll be worth your time if you can spare a minute or two.](http://links.maga-conservatives.com/u/click?_t=da215d85003f407c964bf56cae76557f&_m=afdce9e185f14ab2a7fc5e424f5b660a&_e=WiYQ16k4PQ917zfRzX9npfFeEzvx_1tlu7dDQcS7bqRASjemTeVVCecFCnA5vxKisIIluvagDASf1Xjokyr5_iIi2lAXDwNLDpoTXphW8arO564HZZHoIY0vX2RNaZfmFu_N_zCVKaUO3kbuhceZW2PP4qGSHBppCUVVcfjL_Y9okdaQeyJv4gZjOCGuE6emX2Puo4ouK8-XyX5k576vnR3znPnQ9gZ6sdkVdFKn-YdaKZCP3g3v6akm08ogIEGxzIApTPLnMVOV789YfXO_p58MuUU9BIEttqj8Dgy-Xjjy_haxzUQt4AmFFbUryGqbpz0x19e5FPR_0OGvIh21OFK21iDSHwmzhe1k9RkXuXndhTLtkhxZgWHXjGlrxbPxKzOJgA-OIqm_EZvze2CNQWs1fwnpR9JNqmTj6LRn70cT8nWZiK8ku3Q5FvubD1e5zb24ftAQbZulN_IalhPmsdPHu1TRvlqQxnnGxKV4GKqrZV_Kre62hMX752mMzChuRXQynDB8eifGG4I0B9--_Fztz5LCNBHBSq6NoccNS2yDx4B2DuK92f64IewBHzwB5Hei_rDJdDyzUnkP0bpTmKp2a1jIgf6rrKLFaJ9-n7mpLImuBKHsFn-oOG2n0uH8YPy6YPO9HUYWrhUyI3pPcB1pEFjKujYFv57kCA34Bq8OP93HFuDLDzCJzayUIzBG71oYuz28_XCJVIWvqKCtxhzAR96NIbNhzjCB7qRNwXKNVuvxvvJLWQvWl9q-Wivm)
Where else on the planet can a big-city real estate guy and a small-town hillbilly team up to bring down a political machine to become the leader of the free world and his right hand?
The answer is nowhere but the Shining City on a Hill.
But just like President Reagan, I believe in my heart of hearts that freedom is always a generation away from extinction.
So while I'll never forget Election Night 2024, my sights are set squarely on Election Night 2026.
That's because EVERYTHING comes down to the midterm elections. If the Democrats win back control of Congress, everything we've worked so hard for comes to a SCREECHING HALT!
That's why the Democrat Machine is mobilizing earlier, faster, and more powerfully than anyone thought possible. And we're in for a shellacking if we don't get our act together. Why? Because the Democrats are...
- Unleashing swarms of attack ads in every swing district - just like 2024 - Plastering the media with anti-Trump propaganda - just like all last year - Weaponizing the Deep State to undermine us - just par for the course - Suing us in court to hamstring our agenda - just like Joe Biden did - Tracking to rake in a billion (with a "b") dollars - just like Kamala Harris
They're throwing the kitchen sink at us because everyone knows they can't win on the issues. The American People rejected their agenda of open borders, hostility toward cops, divisive DEI programming, transgender activism, and hating the freest country on Earth.
It's a losing message. I know it. You know it. And they know it too.
That's why the Democrats resort to the ugly, gutter-level politics that pits Americans against each other. They divide so they can conquer.
And the only way they win is if too many Conservatives in our movement rest on our laurels.
The so-called "experts" say that the Democrat Party is fired up and MAGA will sit out this election without Donald Trump on the ballot.
I say they're full of it (as usual).
I believe in this movement. Even though it's early, I have faith that Conservatives who really get it will rise to the challenge and stand with us. ---|---|---
While spending a Saturday on the boat with my family, relaxing and catching some big fish. I got to thinking, what is the big fascination with fishing? ( other than for the obvious reason, like feeding our hunger)

Is it being out on the water at one with nature? When we are born our bodies are like 83% water, which explains some.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=197828298&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk3ODI4Mjk4LCJpYXQiOjE3Nzg5NTEwODAsImV4cCI6MTc4MTU0MzA4MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.BLNB1K2H-WIZQ8F2Ul4KLoYSap3PFBUkZH5kNKXYe2Q)
It's peaceful, except in a storm.

It's a thrill when you catch something for sure. Or maybe it's a gamble every time you cast your reel in the water you never know what you are going to get. It's the thrill of what's down in the deep that might bite that hook.

No matter what it is we have been fishing since the beginning.

What did Jesus mean when He said "I want you to be fishers of men"?
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.7mxWIv9YgK6uUUwRx6_lpdlMVu7MiBjIyW2LnLeRaqs?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=197828298)
Did He want the apostles to get so invested in him that people all around would get hooked and want what they had caught? Then reel them in and get them in the boat wanting to be Christ like. "Live for me," Jesus said.

Let Love be so contagious that you get caught up in the net of love.

Being fishers of men means you are open to people in need. You can guide them, pray for them, feed them, just be a light in anyway to them. "Feed a man a fish and he will eat for a day, teach him to fish and he will eat for life", our Saviour said.

Bottom line, we need to be open to God working through us even sometimes in spite of us and let Him work through us. That is what it means to be fishers of men to me.

Gigi's fish preperation

There is no fresher way to eat fish then to cook what you have caught for the day but if you don't have that opportunity, you can buy fish fillets from the grocery store and really any kind of fish you prefer.

DIRECTIONS

In a pan heat 4 Tbs of olive oil
Mix together in a small bowl
1/4 cup flour
1/4 cup panko crumbs
1/4 tsp sea salt
1/8 tsp pepper
1/8 tsp lemon pepper
1/8 tsp old bay seasoning

In another bowl pour 1/2 cup milk
Dredge the fish in the milk then into crumb seasoning then lay flat in hot pan and cook until browned, turn and cook till done
Squeeze fresh lemon on top and enjoy

It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

clean_body: Why this matters more than ever It's Gary Sinise here. | | | | Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Peter, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. **My political heart changed because becoming a Democrat has made it easier for me to love my neighbor.** As a Republican, if someone didn’t look like me, act like me or vote like me, I couldn’t love them. I couldn’t justify that.

Peter — the time for happy talk is over.

America is being overrun because weak politicians sold out the people they were supposed to protect.

**We need mass deportations. NOW.**

We need to remove every illegal alien who broke our laws, drained our resources, and put American families last.

And yes — _we need a 15-to-20-year moratorium on immigration so this country can finally get a real headcount, secure the border, and figure out who is actually here._

That is not radical.

That is basic national survival.

I'm that guy. I will say the thing every consultant, donor-class puppet, and establishment coward is too afraid to say:

**_If we don't get control of our borders, our cities, our schools, our jobs, and our country — we won't have a country left._**

The answer is not more excuses.

The answer is not more taxpayer-funded resettlement.

**The answer is not letting foreign conflicts, foreign cultures, and foreign problems get dumped into American neighborhoods while working families are told to shut up and pay the bill.**

**America First means Americans come first.**

Period.

And that is exactly why Michele Tafoya refused to show up to the Minnesota GOP Senate Primary debate this past week.

She knew she would be exposed.

She knew voters would see the truth.

Tafoya does not support a real America First agenda. She does not support the kind of border security this moment demands. She was hand-selected by the DC establishment because they know she can be controlled, packaged, and pushed through the system without ever having to answer the hard questions.

That is why she hid.

That is why she ducked the debate.

That is why she thinks she can skip the voters and still walk into the nomination.

Not on my watch.

**Minnesota deserves a fighter who will show up, tell the truth, and put this country first without apology.**

I am not running to impress the donor class.

I am not running to protect the establishment.

I am running to defend this country before it is too late.

Over the past few months, we’ve seen what happens when a federal law enforcement agency is allowed to act without accountability — masked agents rampaging through our streets, families ripped apart, and hardworking people living in fear in their own communities. We don’t deserve to continue like this. That’s exactly why I’m running for Congress. To take this fight to Washington and hold ICE accountable for its abuses while protecting Michigan families. I sponsored and co‐sponsored legislation in the Michigan Senate to rein in lawless federal actions and bring transparency and oversight to enforcement practices that harm everyday people. | | | | | | 🌵 May 16th Legislative & Campaign Update
📰 Op‐Ed Published in the Arizona Capitol TimesEarlier this week, an op‐ed I submitted for publication last Wednesday was published. You can read it at:[https://azcapitoltimes.com/news/2026/05/11/gas-station-heroin-is-putting-arizona-families-at-risk-our-laws-havent-kept-up/](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d6d405f2c1&e=a7ab36849c)
⚖️ Kratom Policy Discussions ContinueEarlier this month, I met with Dean Francis, founder of End Kratom Addiction, during his visit to Arizona. I thought it was important to hear directly from families affected by kratom and to discuss potential policy solutions.
We explored ways to responsibly collaborate on strengthening consumer protections and improving public awareness around unregulated kratom products in Arizona.I also spoke by phone with Patti Wheeler, founder of A Beautiful Life Stolen, whose national advocacy began after the loss of her son, Wyatt. We discussed the importance of educating families and hosting a viewing of her documentary “Kratom: Side Effects May Include” later this year. 🌷 Happy Mother’s DayTo all the moms, grandmothers, and mother figures: thank you for the countless ways you make the world a better place. Mother’s Day is every day, but I hope this past Sunday you took a little time to be honored by those who love you most.
🎓 Congratulations, GraduatesEarlier this week, a large part of our family helped celebrate our daughter’s undergraduate college graduation. We spent the day in Tempe attending Barrett, The Honors College at Arizona State University convocation and the university‐wide commencement later that evening, although we missed another convocation of hers on Thursday.To the countless graduates across our state: your hard work paid off. Those late nights studying into the early hours have brought you one step closer to making your dreams come true. Congratulations! 🏡 Affordable Housing SolutionsThis week I participated in a bipartisan panel discussion with fellow legislators on navigating tradeoffs, tools, and outcomes to achieve our housing goals. At lunch, I was honored to receive the Arizona Housing Coalition’s “Champion of Affordability” award.Arizona families continue to face a housing affordability crisis driven by limited units, bureaucratic red tape, and rising labor and supply costs. I will continue to support solutions that break down these barriers for hardworking Arizonans. First‐time homebuyers want to build equity, many couples want to start a family, and Arizonans want to grow their community. #thereisnoplacelikehome2026 📣 Campaign UpdateIf you live in LD2, you may have noticed our campaign signs springing up. Under current law, May 11th was the first day campaigns could begin placing signs in publicly accessible areas.If you live in LD2 and would like to request a yard sign, please request one [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=1be2523f6d&e=a7ab36849c).
Thank you for your continued support!Best,Shawnna

body:
Because the MAGA crowd knows they can't win otherwise

| |
---|---|---
| | | Forwarded this email? [Subscribe here](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oYWxleWZvcm1pLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.Hm2LOAtls3H4DptNm594zMzH_lCFDX_CXYH15sG3qJM?) for more

# [Voting rights are under fire right in front of our faces](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=197878609&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk3ODc4NjA5LCJpYXQiOjE3Nzg5NTQ2MzEsImV4cCI6MTc4MTU0NjYzMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.wAJwYujjY3v1OVEVN6pJQbIQbY_F_9E8W6dPvgdAXcQ)
### Because the MAGA crowd knows they can't win otherwise
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| May 16
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvaGFsZXlmb3JtaS9wL3ZvdGluZy1yaWdodHMtYXJlLXVuZGVyLWZpcmUtcmlnaHQ_.U0Ny7oIeDmh5zlmfLeLW86RFSUxuAlAY-WoU99G1xk0?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/voting-rights-are-under-fire-right?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends,
**There 's something happening in America right now that we have to be honest about, and it is bigger than any single headline.**
So let's zoom out for a moment.
In _Louisiana v. Callais_ last month, the Supreme Court made it much harder to challenge maps drawn to dilute Black voting power. _The New York Times_ reported that the ruling could allow Republican legislatures to erase around a _dozen_ majority-minority House seats across the South. Justice Elena Kagan warned that **the Court 's decision would set back "the foundational right" of racial equality in representation.**
But before that, there was the SAVE Act: Trump's bill that would restrict the freedom to vote and require Americans to produce a passport or birth certificate to register to vote. But here's the thing: Roughly **half** of American adults do not have a passport. And most married women do not have a birth certificate that matches their current name.
Imagine telling your grandma - who has been voting for decades - that she has to dig through a box in the basement just to prove she can do it again.
And before that, Trump attacked vote-by-mail - the system relied on by seniors, members of our military, disabled voters, and shift workers. The system Trump himself uses, by the way.
This moment could use some blunt Michigan honesty.
**Here 's the truth: This is an effort to dilute the vote of Black Americans and trample on the very ideals this country was founded on.**
This ruling signals something dangerous: that we, as a country, are willing to walk back basic protections that people fought for - and in many cases died for.
I'm talking about the people who marched across the Edmund Pettus Bridge. The activists who worked relentlessly to register Black voters in Mississippi in 1964. Leaders like Martin Luther King Jr. and John Lewis.
In Michigan, we know what democracy looks like when it actually works. In 2024, a record 5.6 million Michiganders cast a ballot, and a big reason for that was vote-by-mail and early voting.
The state did not collapse. The Pistons kept playing, and Coney dogs kept selling.
Here is the part the cable-news pundits will not tell you: Absentee voting - usually by mail - was the most popular way to vote in more than a dozen Michigan counties. Seven of them went for Harris, and seven of them went for Trump.
Turns out, making it easier to vote is not a partisan thing. Folks just want to vote.
That's why we have to stand together - as one country, in every state, in every election - and say no to people who would rather rewrite the rules than accept the results.
[Friends, this is not just a policy fight. It is a moral one.](https://substack.com/redirect/81f9804a-94a6-48c2-b84a-cb85f31be9e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**And I think most Americans, from all different backgrounds, would agree with me if we asked them plainly: Do you believe every eligible American should be able to vote and that their vote should count equally?**
Republicans and Democrats alike should be on the side of democracy. It sounds obvious, but it is worth saying out loud, because too many people in power are acting as if it's somehow optional.
That's why we're fighting back. That's why we're making sure voters know the truth. for the people who don't follow politics. And for the people who follow every second of it.
Because the one thing the folks on the voter suppression side of this fight are counting on is that the rest of us are too tired, too distracted, or too cynical to notice what they are building.
But I noticed. I'm sure you do too.
We're paying attention. We're not going anywhere.
The Voting Rights Act was not a gift.
It was a demand. **It was fought for.**
There was real blood and real sacrifice and real people behind those rights. They were won by Americans who refused to accept injustice.
And now, here we are.
[It's our turn. I'm ready.](https://substack.com/redirect/81f9804a-94a6-48c2-b84a-cb85f31be9e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
With grit,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

subject: Peter, join us on June 10th for a special event!
body:
www.andrewfriedson.com [www.andrewfriedson.com]
Peter,
The race for Montgomery County Executive is in the final stretch—and we need to make sure Andrew has the resources to win.
Andrew is the only candidate who has consistently voted against tax increases, most recently standing firm against a current proposal that would impose a $692 property tax hike on every homeowner. He has a practical plan to grow our economy, and is leading the fight against the cost-of-living crisis in Montgomery County.
Help us finish this race strong—RSVP today! [http://www.andrewfriedson.com/finishline]
Andrew has the vision. Now he needs the resources to get his message out before the Primary Election on June 23rd.
We hope you'll join us at our Race to the Finish event at Burnt Hill Farm—a stunning 117-acre regenerative vineyard in the Montgomery County Agricultural Reserve—where we'll gather with friends and neighbors on the hilltop for estate wines, seasonal hors d'oeuvres, and sweeping farm views.

📅 Wednesday, June 10, 2026 | 🕕 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM
📍 Burnt Hill Farm | 25001 Burnt Hill Rd, Clarksburg, MD 20871

Dan Meuser won't listen to the people here, but I will. Our campaign is showing up in every corner of this district. We're talking directly to every voter we can about what matters to them and what's at stake in November.

Friend,

After celebrating Mother's Day this week, I've been thinking a lot about the sacrifices my mother made for me to be serving in Congress today.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131536545/621438611/1897980251?refcode=em-5.16.26-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTM3MGU3YTgtNTk1MS1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=cVWx9a_VCpFsCPl7Wh04ZTUN21egRW49KyP--DmXOkA=)
My parents fled Vietnam for a chance at a better life in this country, and built their corner store business from the ground up.

It inspired me to enlist in the Army as soon as I could at age 18 to give back. And now I'm honored to be giving back in Congress and getting results for CA-45.

The boy in this photo could never have imagined what was to come. I certainly did not imagine flipping this seat by 653 votes, and in my first re-election race, being ranked as the most vulnerable Democratic incumbent in the state.

**There are so many families with stories like mine that are hurting because of Donald Trump's policies. We have a real opportunity for accountability if Democrats take the House in November.**

It's no exaggeration to say it's impossible without holding this seat. With the primary weeks away, we'll soon have an official opponent – and a whole new set of challenges.

This is exactly the fighter we need to take to the Senate: somebody who has been in a war zone, knows what the questions are, and isn't afraid to ask them out loud. = | = = We need more of this, not less. — Team Moulton | | | ---|---|--- About Seth Moulton Seth Moulton is a Marine and a Democrat with a mission to bring a new generation of leaders to Congress. name: Wes Moore
subject: More must be done
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Aaron Ford
body:
It’s Governor Wes Moore.
Five years ago, I had never run for political office. I was a former Army Captain, a dad to two young kids, and I ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country.
But I knew more had to be done. While career politicians were saying that everything was great, **I was hearing from folks all across Maryland who were feeling left behind.** So I ran for Governor with a mission to make Maryland a state that serves all our people — and won. (And I’m not done yet!)
**Our mission must continue this year.** I’m running for re-election so we can keep building on the progress we’ve made on jobs, education, public safety, and more. There are tough fights on the horizon, and there’s so much more for us to accomplish together.
[**I’m asking you to join our team by chipping in $5 or $10 right now, split between my campaign and****Aaron Ford****. Every dollar we raise helps defend this seat and build a campaign that’s ready for the challenges ahead.**](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260516_1_ak.olkKNG&amount=5&refcode=em20260516-111&t=1&akid=131%2E127862%2Ep7_Z0c)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260516_1_ak.olkKNG&amount=5&refcode=em20260516-111&t=20&akid=131%2E127862%2Ep7_Z0c)**
We’re making real progress — investing historic amounts in public education, bringing down costs for working families, and making our communities safer.
But we’re still in the federal government’s line of sight. Donald Trump has attacked me before, and he and his powerful GOP allies are going to do everything possible to flip our state back to red come November. This election could be an uphill battle.
**This powerful team has never backed down from a fight and I know you are not about to start now.** We have to hit the ground running, because our momentum now determines how we’re able to run the rest of this campaign.
[**Please, split a $5 donation between my campaign and****Aaron Ford****today. Every donation helps us start the next phase of our campaign strong and fight back against Republicans’ advantage.**](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260516_1_ak.olkKNG&amount=5&refcode=em20260516-111&t=21&akid=131%2E127862%2Ep7_Z0c)
It’s time for us to come together again, across places and party lines, to prove to a dysfunctional Washington that there’s a better way forward.
Elevate,
Wes

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
Let me be honest with you about something.
I'm not supposed to be in this race.
The grandson of a sharecropper? Not supposed to be a viable Senate candidate in Louisiana.
A Black farmer from rural Tensas Parish? Not supposed to compete statewide in the Deep South.
Someone without billionaire backers or a Rolodex full of Washington insiders? Not supposed to have a shot at flipping a Senate seat.
But here we are.
And MAGA is absolutely shocked.
They thought Louisiana was locked up. They thought they could focus on defending seats in swing states while the South stayed safely red. They thought a race like ours — a real populist challenge to their grip on power — wasn't possible here.
They were wrong.
Look at what's happening: Democrats flipping Trump districts across the South. MAGA candidates tearing each other apart in primaries. Republican retirements at levels not seen since the Great Depression. Trump's approval cratering over his failed Iran war.
This is a once-in-a-lifetime opening. The kind of moment that doesn't come around often in Louisiana politics.
And I believe — deep in my bones — that this is the campaign to meet this moment.
Not because I'm the most polished politician. Not because I've been planning a Senate run my whole career. But because I understand what working Louisianans need because I've lived their struggles.
I know what it's like to watch costs rise while your income stays flat. I know what it's like to compete against corporations that rig the system against family operations. I know what it's like to worry about whether there will be anything left for the next generation.
That's the authentic economic populism that can win here. Not the fake MAGA version that delivers nothing but culture wars — the real thing that actually fights for working people.
And if we capitalize on this moment — if we show the political world that Louisiana is genuinely winnable — everything changes.
Not just for this race. For the entire map. For what's possible in the South.
But only if we have the resources to compete. And that counts on good folks like you stepping up.
Will you chip in $50, $25, or $10 to help us seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
CHIP IN TO FLIP THIS SENATE SEAT! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
We have the opportunity to pull off something historic in Louisiana that will do a whole lot of good for people here. I couldn’t be more grateful to have you fighting alongside me.
Jamie Davis
Democrat for U.S. Senate

body:
Families who are already struggling to afford groceries, rent, prescriptions, and childcare are now getting hit at the gas pump too.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260516-6247-footer&t=1&akid=6247%2E420207%2EaH-9zc)
Peter,
Groceries, rent, childcare—and now higher gas prices. Trump’s Iran chaos is making life even more expensive.
**And when Trump was asked whether he thinks about the financial pain working people are facing because of it, he said he doesn’t.**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260516._23Bqj&refcode=em20260516-6247&t=2&akid=6247%2E420207%2EaH-9zc)
That tells you everything.
Trump doesn’t lose sleep over whether working people can afford to fuel up their cars, and his billionaire allies don’t either — they can afford it. They might even make money off of it!
**Same Trump, same scam: billionaires get tax breaks, working families get stuck with the bill.**
I refuse to accept a politics where billionaires profit from sending people to war while working people struggle to fill up their tanks and put food on the table.
That’s why I’m fighting for a government that puts working people over corporate greed — but I can’t do it alone.

body:
| | | I’m deeply grateful to everyone who stood with our movement and believed in this campaign. While I’m disappointed in the decision on redistricting, it does not take away from the hard work, dedication, and heart that so many of you poured into this fight. Virginia voted overwhelmingly for a trifecta and got us across the finish line with historic win margins. Virginia voted for the “Yes” referendum, and I hope our Congressional candidates will fight and deliver for a Virginia that works for ALL.
I’m incredibly proud of the movement we built, we had a strong, people-centered message and an extraordinary team to help deliver it. This moment doesn’t change what we fought for, it strengthens our resolve to keep going. Our priorities and message resonated in every corner of the district whether urban, suburban, or rural. Virginians are ready for a government that works for all and not special interests; desperate for comprehensive immigration reform; and, Medicare for All because health care is a human right and not a privilege.
I will be suspending my Congressional campaign and continue serving the residents of House District 22. My campaign was always grounded on the outcome of the redistricting vote, and I look forward to helping deliver more Democrats to Congress in Virginia. This fight was always about pushing back against the chaos and disorder out of DC, and I will continue to be focused on helping everyday Virginians.
Guzman for Congress

body:
We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the full weight of the executive branch bearing down on me right now.
| | |
---
Hey there, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the entire executive branch bearing down on me right now.
After everything you’ve already done for me, I shouldn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131538981/621447137/-1080350292?sourceid=1058787&refcode=WUEFEQ40_20260516_MifeList_ALL&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MWExNjZmYi02YTUxLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BR8L4RqId-dmaRbGreT6Owil2prmiK8ZQO1Ex7Q3Wrs=) Peter, mifepristone remains accessible — for now.

The legal fight is not over, and anti-choice Republicans on the ballot have already shown us exactly what they’ll do with power.

Here are a few names you should know:
1. 1\. **Sen. Lindsey Graham (SC)** introduced a national abortion ban. **Dr. Annie Andrews** is running to replace him in the U.S. Senate. South Carolina deserves to send a doctor, mom, and reproductive freedom champion to Washington.

2. 2\. **Rep. David Valadao (CA-22)** repeatedly voted for a national abortion ban, signed onto the brief urging SCOTUS to overturn _Roe v. Wade,_ and co-sponsored a total ban that would threaten IUDs, IVF, and emergency contraception. **Dr. Jasmeet Bains** is running to replace him.

3. 3\. **Rep. Scott Perry (PA-10)** co-sponsored a total national abortion ban without exceptions. **Janelle Stelson** is running to flip this seat and replace one of the most extreme anti-choice Republicans in Congress.

4. 4\. **Rep. Rob Wittman (VA-01)** has worked to ban abortion his entire career: urging SCOTUS to overturn _Roe_ , co-sponsoring a nationwide ban threatening contraception and IVF, backing limits on mifepristone, and voting to criminalize doctors and patients. **Shannon Taylor** is running to flip his seat.

5. 5\. **Rep. Jeff Crank (CO-05)** co-sponsored a total national abortion ban without exceptions and backed anti-choice legislation used to criminalize doctors. **Jessica Killin** is running to flip Colorado’s 5th congressional district and replace him with a leader who will protect our freedoms.

6. 6\. **Rep. Derrick Van Orden (WI-03)** called himself “ardently pro-life,” compared abortion to “genocide,” called rape and incest exceptions “evil,” and voted for anti-choice legislation used to criminalize doctors. **Rebecca Cooke** is running to send him to an early retirement.

And this does not stop in Congress.
1. 7\. In Georgia, Justices **Charlie Bethel** and **Sarah Warren** joined the majority that temporarily reinstated Georgia’s six-week abortion ban. **Jen Jordan** and **Miracle Rankin** are running for Georgia Supreme Court because state courts are on the front lines.

2. 8\. **State Rep. Pat Catena (PA-HD45)** is a Pennsylvania Democrat who has been backed by anti-abortion group LifePAC _four times_ because of his anti-choice views. **Brittany Bloam** is the pro-choice woman in this district. The choice is clear.

Mifepristone is still accessible today.

But the people trying to ban abortion, criminalize doctors, restrict contraception, and gut our rights are still running for office.

Another round of intense fighting in the mountains of southern Mexico resulted in up to 1,000 Mexicans fleeing their homes, telling stories of drones dropping bombs, homes being set on fire, and livestock being needlessly killed.

**" Corpus Christi Faces Water Crisis as Drought and Industrial Growth Strain Supply"** via [The New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/babd9d8d-3420-43af-8885-95952b4e6456?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Lauren McGaughy** - Corpus Christi's industrial port has been expanding, but new water sources have not been keeping pace, especially amid a drought that has stretched on far longer than local officials expected.

The mayor of Corpus Christi called an emergency meeting last month to deliver a dire warning: The city, among the largest in Texas, was running out of water. City leaders had to make a plan, and fast.

"Every day of delay increases uncertainty," the mayor, **Paulette Guajardo** , told the City Council. Officials had warned that demand for water could outstrip supply within months.

Corpus Christi, a coastal city of more than 300,000 and home to a large industrial port, is not alone in grappling with water shortages. Half the nation is dealing with a persistent drought, according to federal data, at the same time as industrial water demand has risen because of growing needs from power plants and data centers. _([The New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/babd9d8d-3420-43af-8885-95952b4e6456?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Census: Texas had 8 of country's fastest growing cities in 2025"** via [The Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/255cfda3-9a56-43cb-a951-0c292ddf244b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Joshua Fechter** and **Dan Keemahill** - Fewer people are moving to Texas cities amid the country's broader immigration slowdown, but the state remains home to some of the fastest growing cities in the country, new U.S. Census Bureau data show.

Celina, a city about an hour north from downtown Dallas, was the fastest growing city in the country last year, according to census data released Thursday. The city grew by 24.6%, adding more than 12,710 residents between July 2024 and July 2025.

Eight of the 15 fastest-growing cities in the U.S. are in Texas -- primarily suburbs in the Dallas-Fort Worth region, the state's largest urban area. Meanwhile, some of the state's biggest cities like Houston, San Antonio and Fort Worth are still adding tens of thousands of residents -- despite a slowdown in international migration to the United States and lower birth rates.

Other places in Texas are struggling, including some of its biggest cities. Out of the state's 15 largest cities, six lost residents: Dallas, El Paso, Arlington, Plano, Irving and Garland. _([TX TRIB](https://substack.com/redirect/255cfda3-9a56-43cb-a951-0c292ddf244b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Austin's population surpasses 1 million residents for the first time in history"** via KEYE -- For the first time in its history, Austin's population has surpassed 1 million residents.

New census data confirmed that Austin's population broke 1 million people in 2025, the City saying that 1,002,632 residents now call Texas' capital city home, an increase of over 4,000 residents since July 2024.

Austin is now the 12th most populous city in the country, according to the City.

"This is a historic moment for Austin, and one that my predecessor **Edwin Waller** probably didn't even think about when he surveyed the site that would eventually become our beloved city back in 1839," said Mayor **Kirk Watson**. "There's no denying now that Austin is a big city, and we have big challenges. But we also still have small town heart, and that's part of what makes it the best place in the country to raise a family or to seek out new opportunities." _([KEYE](https://substack.com/redirect/1ea9b1c9-75ae-4cc4-bd7e-89c2a01afb1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_
